reviewText: Finally, a puzzle game that actually makes you think! The steampunk aesthetic is beautiful and the haptic feedback on the gear spins feels premium.
Game ka concept bahut unique hai, slots jaisa dikhta hai par bilkul alag logic puzzle hai. Thoda aur levels add karo toh maza ayega.
Solid puzzle experience. Runs perfectly on my phone without any heating issues. The spin limits make it really challenging.
